Messages.Author: Blooded Sand
Messages.Body:
Eze targets Thetmes with a blood of sandman at THA. Thetmes plays a
Black sunrise to untap and attempt to block. The block fails. Thetmes
is untapped, does the BotS fail due to the target not being a TAPPED
younger vampire?

Blood of Sandman
[tha] +1 stealth action. (D) Burn an ally.
[THA] +6 stealth action. (D) Put this card on a ready younger tapped
vampire. Reaction cards this vampire plays while tapped are canceled
as they are played. Burn this card if this vampire goes to torpor.
